360678:qcs.local_text: This program supports basic research pursuing novel catalyst design and molecular-level control of chemical transformations relevant to the conversion of energy resources. Emphasis is on the understanding of reaction mechanisms, enabling precise identification and manipulation of catalytic active sites, their environments, and reaction conditions for optimized efficiency and selectivity. Elucidation of catalytic reaction mechanisms in varied chemical environments and the structure-reactivity relationships of solid and molecular catalysts comprises a central component of the program.
